name: Eggertsville-Snyder Branch Library - Mahjong Club
description: Library's own event page: "Learn to play American Mahjong, or use one of our tables for your party of four." The 2026 series page says both Early Chinese style and American mahjong are available; tiles, mats and racks provided. Registration by stopping by or calling the branch. Held in Snyder (Amherst).
schedule: Tuesdays 3:30-5:30pm (2026 dates seen: Sep 29, Oct 13, Oct 27; later dates not confirmed)
